windows-modern.description: Windows 10 1803 and newer (including Windows 11). Modern feature set: WGC capture, full UI Automation, mandatory integrity levels, UIPI, WIC image codecs, WIC-backed PNG/WebP/BMP. The default Windows family for new agent installs.
windows-modern.token_file_acl: Local Administrators (full control) + agent run-as account (read). Inherited permissions disabled. Token rotates on every agent start.

windows-classic.description: Windows NT 4 through Windows 8.1, plus Windows 9x where applicable. No UI Automation, no WGC, no UIPI; GDI BitBlt capture only. PNG via GDI+ runtime if present (XP+ ships GDI+; NT 4 needs the redist). Multi-monitor on 2000 and later. Used for the legacy Windows agent build.
windows-classic.token_file_acl: Local Administrators (full control) + agent run-as account (read), enforceable on NTFS only. On FAT32 the token file is plaintext-readable by every user on the machine; tier elevation degrades to a per-machine-trust model. Token rotates on every agent start.
